name: Il Sereno
tagline: Forty lake-facing suites in Torno, with a freshwater pool.
description:
Il Sereno is a hotel on the shore at Torno, on Lake Como, at Via Torrazza 10, 22020 Torno. It has 40 suites, a spa, a private beach and dock, and the restaurant Al Lago. Sereno Hotels operates it. The hotel is less than 6 km, about 4 miles, from the centre of Como, an eight-minute drive, and about fifty minutes from Milano Malpensa airport and from the centre of Milan.

Patricia Urquiola designed the interiors. The 40 suites run from 50 square metres to the Penthouse at more than 200 square metres, with floor-to-ceiling windows toward the water. Patrick Blanc made three vertical gardens here, named on the hotel site Le Mirroir Vert du Lac, Le Canyon and Les Racines Echassees. The spa sits under the original century-old arches. A private beach and a dock serve the house, and three classic wooden boats by Ernesto Riva are kept for the lake.

The pool is a 60-foot freshwater infinity pool, heated, set over the water, with a sundeck. Al Lago is the restaurant, with chef Raffaele Lenzi. The house also has a lobby bar and a wine cellar. Fitness trainers can be requested, and spa treatments can be taken in the suite. The pool is the long edge of the day, and the boats are how guests arrive from the water as well as how they leave it.

The drive from Como is short, and the longer transfer is the one from Milan or Malpensa, both given as about fifty minutes. The telephone is +39 031 547 7800 and the email is info@ilsereno.com. Press enquiries go to sales@serenohotels.com.

The hotel suits a stay that stays on the water: the suites face the lake, the pool is suspended over it, and the boats leave from the dock. Como is a few minutes by car when the day calls for the town. Milan is the longer drive, about fifty minutes, when the arrival is by air through Malpensa or from the city itself.
